title: the-ground-loop-reads-the-tools-cadence
intention: The ground loop stops defining its own CADENCE_S and imports the ruled cadence from the liveness tool, so the heartbeat interval has one definition site and nothing outside the cairn device needs the loop's __main__ to learn it.
why: RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01): every component talks to another only through its public interface; a ticket's build lives inside its own component and its proofs and hollow measure only that component. The ruled cadence was spelled inside the cairn device, and launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py:59 reached in for it — one of 80 encapsulation_breaches measured 2026-10-05. Split from 48c0c58a1714 at Akien's word, 2026-10-05: "we said that devices never cross boundaries, that's why we're making these changes. and we said that then we'd only have to run the tests for the changed files and not for all files."
how: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py deletes its line `CADENCE_S = 60.0 ...` and adds CADENCE_S to its existing import from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness; main()'s default cadence is unchanged. Depends on c3b14029d6d8 (the tool defines CADENCE_S). One new proof in ground_loop/proofs/, already written red.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py has no top-level assignment to CADENCE_S; (2) it imports CADENCE_S from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness; (3) main()'s default cadence is the name CADENCE_S and __main__.CADENCE_S is the tool's object. RED if any fails or cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_stop_is_prompt.py goes red. WRONG INTENT if the loop needs a cadence different from the ruled one.
watchme: none, because the build_inspector's encapsulation_breaches sieve (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) already reds any new reach across a component boundary on every inspection
children: none, because the change is one component's edit plus its one proof, already on disk at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_the_ground_loop_reads_the_tools_cadence.py

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py, change line 44 `from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness import read_liveness, write_liveness` to `from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness import CADENCE_S, read_liveness, write_liveness`.

D2: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py, delete line 47 `CADENCE_S = 60.0  # the ruled cadence: once per minute (Akien, 2026-08-22)`. main()'s signature `cadence: float = CADENCE_S` stays as it is. Nothing else in the file changes.

D3: SETTLED: the proof cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_the_ground_loop_reads_the_tools_cadence.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 3/3 at HEAD (2026-10-05). It is committed at the BUILDME crossing; D1-D2 turn it green and do not edit it.

D4: SETTLED: BUILDME waits for c3b14029d6d8 PROVED (the tool must define CADENCE_S before the import resolves). Run cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_stop_is_prompt.py before the build (measured exit 0, 2026-10-05) and after (exit 0). Commit cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py alone naming 3415a742fd0a, letting the pre-commit reseal door reseal. No file outside cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop changes.
